text:
incident-bot: Pager triggered -> service: inference-gateway, alert: http_5xx_rate_high, severity: high, threshold: 8% over 2m. Pager: pd-team-inference.

pagerduty: Incident created #INC-23245 -> paging kevin (on-call) (rotation).

kevin (on-call): acked. I'm looking. :eyes: any initial impact notes?

mariam (SRE): seeing 5xx rate spike from 2 regions (us-west1, eu-west1). Errors are mostly 502/504 from ingress -> backend timeouts. Spike started ~4598765370 (approx 1m before page).

jun (infra): spotting elevated connection reset counts on edge LB, and a small cluster in us-west1 showing high CPU on proxy pods. dumping tail of ingress logs now.

mariam (SRE): logs snippet:```
[2026-03-14T21:10:22Z] proxy/conn.go: timeout writing to backend (id=pod-xyz) 504
[2026-03-14T21:10:23Z] gateway: downstream req id=abc123 route=/v1/generate status=502 backend_err=kv-cache-stall
[2026-03-14T21:10:24Z] proxy: upstream reset read: connection reset by peer
```

kevin (on-call): possible K/V cache eviction or backend overload. Are we seeing increase in tail latency to model workers?

mariam (SRE): yes, model-worker p99 tok latency up 3x in the affected cells. KV cache evictions correlate with spike. Also a recent autoscaler bump may have left some nodes under memory pressure.

ops-bot: Route-level error rate: /v1/generate -> 11.6% 5xx (2m window). Top callers: prod-api-key-01 (70%), partner-ingest (12%).

kevin (on-call): quick mitigation options: 1) throttle heavy callers (rate-limit by key), 2) fail open to lower-latency model-variant (cheaper) for non-SLA customers, 3) roll back recent autoscaler/infra changes. Which is fastest?

mariam (SRE): throttle prod-api-key-01 by 30% immediately. That should buy ~40% reduction in pressure. Also warm fallback model in eu-west1 and route 25% traffic there. I'll trigger warmup.

jun (infra): running rate-limit command now:```sh
kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: routing.redwood/v1
kind: RateLimit
metadata:
  name: throttle-prod-key-01
spec:
  apiKey: prod-api-key-01
  qps: 50
EOF
```

jun (infra): rate-limit applied. Should see effect in next 30s.

mariam (SRE): warming fallback model variant on eu-west1: initiating canary spinup and KV cache prefill (prompt set warmup).

sara (eng-runtime): FYI I pushed a small canary config to lower mem pressure on worker pool yesterday at 21:00 UTC — rolling that back might help if it changed eviction behavior. Who wants to rollback?

kevin (on-call): mariam, do you want rollback in us-west1 while fallback warms? If rollback takes >5m maybe skip.

mariam (SRE): rollback queued. rolling back canary in us-west1 now (command: /run rollback canary worker-config us-west1).

ops-bot: Rollback started by mariam. Job id rb-7822.

(45s later)

mariam (SRE): rollback complete. Noted fewer evictions on new pods. Observability: ingress 5xx from us-west1 dropped from 12% -> 6.5% in 60s. still seeing eu-west1 ~9%

kevin (on-call): good. mariam, status on fallback warm?

mariam (SRE): fallback warmup at 70% completed; prefill successful on most hot prefixes. Starting 25% routing to fallback variant in eu-west1.

jun (infra): applying routing override:```json
{ "route": "/v1/generate", "weight": {"model:fallback-v2": 25, "model:primary": 75} }
```

jun (infra): override applied.

ops-bot: Global 5xx rate -> 7.2% (2m). us-west1 4.1%, eu-west1 6.8%. Request volume unchanged.

kevin (on-call): starting customer-impact assessment. mariam, can we check number of requests returning 5xx in last 5m and any customer 100% failures?

mariam (SRE): counts: 5xx total 18.3k in last 5m. Affected keys: prod-api-key-01 (12.9k), partner-ingest (2.1k). No single customer at 100% failure, but degraded. filing a P0 alert to CS to prepare messaging for top 5 partners.

kevin (on-call): escalation: pd notify -> escalation: on-call infra lead jun and eng-runtime sara. tagging them now. @jun @sara please join incident channel.

jun (infra): here. looking into LB connection reset pattern. Initial hypothesis: proxy sidecar on a subset of nodes had a restart loop which saturated others. pulling node events.

sara (eng-runtime): joining. I can assist with routing fallbacks and long-term fix for eviction tuning. Suggest we keep fallback active for 30m, then re-evaluate.

kevin (on-call): agreed. Action items: 
- [kevin] throttle prod API key (done)
- [jun] monitor LB connection resets and coordinate with infra to drain bad nodes
- [mariam] monitor 5xx rate and KV cache health, confirm warmup effectiveness
- [sara] prepare rollback/deployment patch if we see config regressions
- [kevin] notify CS + SOC on potential customer impact

mariam (SRE): quick check: cache hit-rate improved after rollback from 62% -> 81% on worker-side kv. p99 token latency trending down.

ops-bot: Alert volume reducing. Current global 5xx 3.8% (2m).

kevin (on-call): looks like mitigation working. I'll keep channel open for followup. If anything regresses, re-page.

(20m later)

mariam (SRE): final check: 5xx sustained at ~1.2% (near baseline). KV cache stable. Rolling back routing override to primary 100% in 5m.

jun (infra): drain and cordon one bad node from us-west1 cluster. Node had repeated sidecar restarts, kernel dmesg showed OOM kill on sidecar process. marking for replacement.

sara (eng-runtime): opened a follow-up ticket: EW-2962 "Investigate worker autoscaler bump -> cache eviction sequence" and assigned to eng-runtime. Includes runbook steps and perf traces.

kevin (on-call): handing off to sara (eng-runtime) for post-incident follow-ups and RCA. Next on-call: sara. Please confirm acceptance.

sara (eng-runtime): accepting handoff. I'll own RCA and customer comms draft.

kevin (on-call): thanks all. Incident will be marked resolved once postmortem ticket has initial notes. Closing pager now. :white_check_mark: 

incident-bot: Incident #INC-23245 status -> resolved by kevin (on-call). Duration: ~29m.

mariam (SRE): quick note for postmortem: correlate autoscaler event at 21:00 with spike. propose default mem headroom increase and improved prefill for cache on scaling events.

sara (eng-runtime): noted. will include remediation proposals.

kevin (on-call): final checkin at 4598765700.
